topic: Leviathan FLNG status vs. Jan 2026 expansion FID and Egypt pipeline route
wiki_text: In August 2025 Leviathan's partners signed Israel's largest-ever gas export deal (~US$35 billion) to supply gas to Egypt, and subsequently finalized a ~US$610 million contract with Israel Natural Gas Lines for a ~65 km pipeline (Ramat Hovav to the Nitzana border crossing) to expand exports to Egypt. On 16 January 2026 Chevron (via Chevron Mediterranean Ltd, 39.66% operator), NewMed Energy (45.34%) and Ratio Energies (15%) took a Final Investment Decision to expand Leviathan field production toward ~21 bcm/y. This FID covers the pipeline-based production expansion, not the proposed floating LNG (FLNG) export terminal. As of mid-2025 the FLNG unit (Leviathan Phase 1B, ~4.6 mtpa / ~7 bcm/y) remained a longer-term option still under consideration, with no FEED or FID taken; the near-term commercialization path has shifted toward pipeline exports to Egyptian LNG plants rather than an Israeli FLNG facility.
